server.title: MetricDuck — Financial Analysis
server.description: Research U.S. public companies from their SEC filings: financials, XBRL facts and filing text.

serverInfo.name: metricduck
serverInfo.description: SEC filing data and signals for AI agents — structured financials, filing signal screening across filings/earnings/transcripts/IR events, sector-normalized peer comparisons, stock screening, daily end-of-day stock prices, and raw XBRL facts, covering ~6,000 SEC filers. Fundamentals and filing text from SEC EDGAR (new 8-K and 10-Q text typically about 7–8 minutes after SEC acceptance, median); end-of-day prices from a market-data feed.
